events.description: A group of senior former Israeli military officers assisted Palestinian farmers in harvesting olives as a gesture of solidarity amid rising tensions.

events.title: Gas reserves in European storage facilities at lowest level since 2013
events.description: IEA data shows EU gas storage at 75 % capacity, the lowest level since 2013, raising concerns over energy security ahead of winter.

events.title: Israel detains Al Jazeera journalist in Hebron raids
events.description: Israeli forces detained Al Jazeera reporter Montaser Nassar during raids near Hebron, heightening diplomatic friction with the press organization.

events.title: Poland sends forces to Russian border as 'disturbing movement' detected
events.description: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk ordered substantial troops to the border with Russia after intelligence reported unusual activity in Kaliningrad.

events.title: Zelenskyy on defying US in attacking Russian oil: 'Our response must be painful'
events.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy announced that Ukraine will continue striking Russian oil refineries despite U.S. objections, intensifying the energy‑war dimension of the conflict.

events.title: Ukrainian President Zelenskyy to make surprise Berlin visit this Tuesday, Merz says
events.description: Zelenskyy will travel to Germany for talks aimed at reviving peace negotiations with Moscow.

events.title: Iran's Foreign Minister says talks with Saudi Arabia are ongoing; Yemen fighting intensifies
events.description: Iran and Saudi Arabia continue diplomatic talks while hostilities between Saudi forces and Yemen’s Houthi rebels increase.

events.title: Egypt-Sudan sign agreement to defend water security
events.description: Egypt and Sudan agree to cooperate on protecting water resources in the Eastern Nile Basin and reject unilateral actions on the GERD.

events.title: The Pope arrives in an Argentina where bishops are among Milei’s firmest critics
events.description: Pope Leo XIV lands in Buenos Aires, marking a high‑profile pastoral visit amid tensions with the Argentine government.

events.title: Shell to sell Australian gas stake to Abu Dhabi’s XRG for $1.45bn
events.description: Shell agrees to divest its Australian gas assets to Abu Dhabi‑based XRG as part of its strategy to shed mature holdings.

events.title: U.S. military carries out limited strikes on Iran’s Qeshm Island
events.description: American forces conduct limited missile strikes on Iran’s Qeshm Island, marking a direct military action amid heightened tensions.

events.title: Multiple explosions heard on Qeshm Island and Bandar Lengeh in Iran
events.description: Residents reported a series of explosions on Qeshm Island and in the nearby port city of Bandar Lengeh, raising security concerns in the Persian Gulf region.

events.title: Fridge cyberattack hits supermarkets across Europe
events.description: A coordinated cyberattack targeted freezer systems in supermarkets across multiple European countries, causing food spoilage.

events.title: King Charles to address slavery discussion with 'unflinching honesty' in Commonwealth speech
events.description: King Charles will speak to Commonwealth leaders about Britain's role in transatlantic slavery, signalling a diplomatic acknowledgement.

events.title: Russia bombs aid centre and shelter in southern Ukraine, killing 24
events.description: A Russian air strike hit an aid centre and shelter in Zaporizhzhia region, killing at least 24 people.

events.title: Russia Senses Opportunity in Polish Political Turmoil
events.description: Moscow is leveraging Poland's constitutional crisis to weaken European support for Ukraine, indicating a strategic diplomatic push.

events.title: German MPs and officials targeted in spyware attack
events.description: German lawmakers were hit by a Pegasus‑like spyware campaign, raising concerns over political security and intelligence operations.

events.title: Iran, pronti a riaprire Hormuz in 2 giorni se Usa accettano condizioni
events.description: Iran says it can reopen the Strait of Hormuz within two days if the United States meets its conditions, affecting global oil shipping.

events.title: The first Asia‑Pacific Economic Cooperation (Apec) forum finance ministers’ meeting to be held in Hong Kong focused on openness, cooperation and resilience
events.description: Finance ministers gathered in Hong Kong for the APEC meeting, signalling continued regional trade dialogue and potential agreements.

events.title: Bulgarians re‑elect pro‑Russian president
events.description: Interim president Iliana Yotova, known for her Kremlin‑friendly stance, wins the presidential election, shifting Bulgaria’s foreign policy closer to Moscow.

events.title: Frankfurt riots linked to migrants, dozens of police injured
events.description: Violent clashes in Frankfurt left over 100 police officers injured, with officials saying most rioters had migrant backgrounds.

events.title: Ukraine's air alert system hacked after false radiation warning in Kyiv
events.description: A cyber intrusion caused false radiation and chemical attack alerts across Kyiv, prompting panic and highlighting vulnerabilities in Ukraine's civil defense systems.

events.title: Canada PM Carney says he had good conversation with Trump on trade
events.description: Canadian Prime Minister Justin Carney reported a constructive trade discussion with U.S. President Donald Trump.

events.title: Queen Camilla joins King Charles for the first time in Antigua ahead of major Commonwealth meeting
events.description: Charles and Camilla attended a service in Antigua marking the start of a high‑level Commonwealth gathering.

events.title: Mitsubishi Heavy gears up to boost US gas turbine production
events.description: Mitsubishi Heavy Industries incrementará la fabricación de turbinas de gas en Estados Unidos para reforzar la cadena de suministro energético.

events.title: Saudi-backed Yemeni forces claim to have thwarted advancing Houthis
events.description: Fuerzas gubernamentales yemeníes respaldadas por Arabia Saudita afirman haber detenido una ofensiva de los rebeldes hutíes en el suroeste del país.

events.title: Longest truce of Ukraine war, in Kherson region, set to end
events.description: El cese de hostilidades más prolongado en la guerra de Ucrania, mediado por la primera dama de EE. UU., está programado para concluir sin extensión.

events.title: Ukraine‑skeptic President Wins Bulgaria’s Vote, Exit Poll Shows
events.description: El presidente pro‑Ucrania de Bulgaria, Iliana Yotova, fue reelegida, consolidando la posición del primer ministro escéptico de Kiev.

events.title: Joint List MK investigated on suspicion of receiving Qatari funding during Israel's 2026 elections
events.description: An Israeli lawmaker is under investigation for alleged Qatari financial support ahead of the 2026 elections.

events.title: Russian forces strike cargo ship delivering supplies to Ukraine near Odessa
events.description: Russian forces hit a cargo vessel 16 km southeast of Odessa, Ukraine, that was carrying supplies for Ukrainian troops.

events.title: Trump says U.S. still has to "take care" of more targets in Iran
events.description: President Trump warned that the United States has additional targets in Iran that still need to be addressed.

events.title: Kherson truce lets Ukrainian family ‘close chapter’ on old life
events.description: A truce in Kherson allows a Ukrainian family to begin rebuilding their lives after the city changed hands.

events.title: Pro‑EU Polish PM brings ‘Russian bots’ into court showdown
events.description: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk accuses political rivals of receiving assistance from Russian bots, leading to a court confrontation.

events.title: North Korea tests cluster bomb warheads in latest ‘major’ weapons test
events.description: La Corea del Nord ha effettuato un test di testate a grappolo, dimostrando capacità di distruzione su ampia area.

events.title: Repubblica Centrafricana, esercito sventa tentativo di presa del potere dei miliziani
events.description: L'esercito della Repubblica Centrafricana ha fermato un tentativo di colpo di stato da parte di miliziani, garantendo la prosecuzione delle elezioni.

events.title: North Korea says defence research institutes tested major weapon system
events.description: Pyongyang announced that its defence research institutes have conducted a test of a new major weapon system, indicating an escalation in its military capabilities.

events.title: Dozens arrested outside US Embassy in London for supporting proscribed pro‑Palestinian group
events.description: London police detained dozens of demonstrators outside the U.S. Embassy who were protesting in support of the banned group Palestine Action.

events.title: Ukrainian evacuees reunite with family after years trapped in Russia‑occupied city
events.description: Families from Oleshky were reunited after a US‑brokered ceasefire enabled their safe return to Ukraine.

events.title: US Embassy warns of credible 'mass casualty' threat at popular Moscow tourist attraction
events.description: L'Ambasciata USA a Mosca ha avvertito di una minaccia credibile di attacco di massa al complesso museale di Tsaritsyno.

events.title: U.K. Leader Burnham Hints At Apology For Country's Role In Slave Trade But Rejects Reparations
events.description: Il Primo Ministro britannico ha suggerito un possibile scuse per il ruolo del Regno Unito nella tratta degli schiavi, senza accettare richieste di riparazioni.

events.title: Evacuees from Russian‑occupied city arrive in Ukraine
events.description: A humanitarian mission extracted hundreds of people from Oleshky, a city under Russian occupation, and brought them to safety in Ukraine.

events.title: China's coast guard conducts patrols east of Taiwan, CCTV reports
events.description: China's coast guard carried out routine law‑enforcement patrols in waters east of Taiwan, heightening tensions across the Taiwan Strait.

events.title: Qatari mediators held talks in Tehran aimed at restarting direct U.S.-Iran negotiations, source says
events.description: Qatari envoys met Iranian officials in Tehran for more than 12 hours to try to revive direct talks between Washington and Tehran.

events.title: Hundreds from Russian-occupied Oleshky land in Belarus en route to Ukraine
events.description: Four planes carrying evacuees from the war‑ravaged city of Oleshky arrived in Belarus' Gomel region before proceeding to Ukraine.

events.title: Saudi Arabia says intercepted ‘hostile drone’ in Riyadh region
events.description: Saudi authorities reported the interception of an unidentified hostile drone over the Riyadh region, though the launch source remains unknown.

events.title: US courts two Chinese nationals for espionage
events.description: Two Chinese citizens were sentenced in Washington for running a “dead‑drop” espionage network that transferred cash to agents in the United States.

events.title: Poland’s constitutional court crisis sparks riots in Warsaw
events.description: Riot police were deployed to the Constitutional Tribunal in Warsaw as protesters demanded the reinstatement of the court’s president, heightening political tension.

events.title: New transit rules and green incentives for Panama Canal
events.description: Panama announced revised scheduling priorities and environmental incentives for vessels transiting the canal, aiming to boost sustainable trade flows.

events.title: Pope Leo XIV begins South American tour in Montevideo
events.description: Pope Leo XIV arrived in Montevideo to start a multi‑country visit, meeting President Yamandú Orsi and holding open‑air Masses, signaling diplomatic outreach in the region.

events.title: US approves sale of 500 Patriot missiles to Ukraine
events.description: The United States authorized the transfer of 500 Patriot air‑defence missiles to Ukraine to bolster its capability against Russian ballistic missiles.

events.title: Chile’s stock market drops 2.76% amid US tech sell‑off
events.description: Chile’s IPSA index fell sharply as a broader Wall Street rout impacted investor sentiment, marking a notable regional financial shock.

events.title: South Korean, U.S., Japanese FMs reaffirm 'resolute commitment' to complete denuclearization of N. Korea
events.description: Foreign ministers from South Korea, the United States and Japan met in Washington and pledged continued effort toward North Korea’s denuclearization.

events.title: Polish police deployed to top court after head judge suspended
events.description: Polish police were sent to the Constitutional Tribunal in Warsaw following the suspension of its chief judge, intensifying a domestic power struggle.
